evidence.claim: Flagged transaction 3437584 ($22.84, product C, online) scores 0.78 on the calibrated transaction model trained only on the bank's closed cases (out-of-time AUC 0.964 vs 0.866 for the bank's risk score). The bank's own risk score was 0.14.
Holder baseline from 5 earlier transactions: median $26.52, 95th percentile $39.50; the flagged amount is 0.9x the median.
Device profile 'SM-A300H Build/LRX22G | ? | chrome 65.0 for android | ?' was used by this holder before; identity record marks it Found.
Simulated customer validation: Cardholder states they did not make this transaction and still has the card.
Card-not-present fraud: the number used online without the card; amounts and products that don't fit the cardholder, often two to four within 48 hours.
Policy R2: Customer denies the transaction: BLOCK_CARD and CREATE_CASE; FILE_REPORT if exposure exceeds $1,000 or the case connects to a shared device profile or another card's fraud.
